text_english: it is raining outside, there is lots of mud.

text_koine: ἡ Πάνδα καὶ ἡ Κοάλα θέλουσι παίζειν ἔξω ἐν τῷ ὑετῷ.
text_english: Panda and Koala want to play outside in the rain.
artist_notes: Panda and Koala are looking out a window at the rain outside; Panda is to the left of the window and Koala to the right and only the back of their heads are visible because they are looking out the window.

text_koine: ἡ Πάνδα καὶ ἡ Κοάλα ἐξέρχονται ἔξω.
artist_notes: Panda is half in the house/half out, and Koala is already out of the house and moving away from the house. It is raining.
it is raining; the mud puddles should be large and exagerated; both panda and koala are running in the same direction and they are muddy

text_english: they build a tower from mud.
artist_notes: the mud tower should be taller than Panda/Koala and like the spire of a castle. Panda and Koala are dirty from the mud.

text_english: they dig a chasm in the mud.
artist_notes: draw a top-down shot with an enormous hole bigger than a house; Koala and Panda are small inside the hole digging with shovels; it looks like a miniature construction scene; it is raining and panda and koala are both very muddy

text_koine: ἡ Πάνδα βάλλει τὴν σφαῖραν τῇ Κοάλᾳ.
text_english: Panda throws the ball to Koala.
artist_notes: it is raining and there is mud everywhere; both panda and koala are covered in mud

text_koine: ἡ Κοάλα πίπτει εἰς τὸν πηλόν.
artist_notes: koala is covered in mud and very dirty looking

text_koine: ἡ Κοάλα καὶ ἡ Πάνδα μάλα ῥυπαραί εἰσιν.
text_english: Koala and Panda are very messy.
artist_notes: it is raining and there is mud everywhere; this should be a closeup shot of koala and panda and their dirtiness with barely any background visible

text_koine: ἡ Κοάλα καὶ ἡ Πάνδα εἰσέρχονται εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν. φέρουσι πηλὸν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν.
text_english: Koala and Panda go in the house, they bring mud in the house.
artist_notes: both Panda and Koala are very muddy; Panda is half outside/half inside; Koala is fully inside; Koala has mud prints behind him; it is raining outside and both panda and koala are very muddy; they are oblivious to their mud

text_koine: ἡ Πάνδα καὶ ἡ Κοάλα παίζουσιν ἐν τῇ ἑστίᾳ καὶ νῦν ἡ ἑστία ῥυπαρά ἐστιν.
text_english: Panda and Koala play in the diningroom and now the diningroom is dirty.
artist_notes: Panda and Koala are very muddy and they are building another mud castle on the dining room table; mud is everywhere

text_koine: ἡ Γλαῦξ βλέπει τὴν Πάνδαν καὶ τὴν Κοάλαν καὶ ὀργίζεται. λέγει· «λούεσθε!»
text_english: Owl sees Panda and Koala and is mad, he says: clean yourselves!
artist_notes: this is a closeup shot on owls face only; owl is very surprised/mad and his eyes are popping out of his head with rage; there is mud everywhere. Panda/Koala are not visible, only Owl's head is visible with mud in the background.

text_koine: ἡ Πάνδα καὶ ἡ Κοάλα λούονται ἐν τῷ λουτρῷ.
text_english: Panda and Koala take a bath in the bathroom.

text_koine: ἡ Γλαῦξ λέγει· «νῦν καθαρίζετε τὴν ἑστίαν!»
text_english: Owl says: now clean the diningroom!
artist_notes: close up shot of owl's head only/no feet visible; owl has a stern expression

text_koine: ἡ Πάνδα καὶ ἡ Κοάλα καθαρίζουσι τὴν ἑστίαν.
text_english: Panda and Koala clean the diningroom.
artist_notes: Panda is using a mop and Koala is using rags on the table; most of the room is clean but there is still a small pile of mud on the table that needs to be cleaned.

text_koine: νῦν πάντα καθαρά ἐστιν, καὶ πάντες χαίρουσιν.
text_english: now everything is clean, and everyone is happy.
artist_notes: show the tables/floors shining like it has been newly cleaned; there is a mop and rags in the corner.
